title: A notification can be marked read or unread and shows its attachments
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Inbox tab.
  • A notification whose note carries an attachment, from a note a second user wrote on a work order.
custom_steps:
1. Toggle a single notification between read and unread.
  2. Read a notification whose note has attachments.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • You can toggle a single notification between read and unread.
  • When a notification has attachments, they are shown on the notification.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10245 (S2, Read a notification); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S2; design board InboxAfter; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R11: “The user can toggle a single notification between read and unread.”
  • S2-R12: “When a notification has attachments, they are shown on the notification.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
